topology: Shared ALL-land G/W/S occupancy for all materials. Connected contacts never receive a cap or outline.
geometry: Compact 3x3 biweight occupancy field; 256 full 8-neighbour states; 22px base overhang plus two broad 7px lobes; logical cell unchanged.
sourceProcessing: Fresh V02 imagegen raster interiors sampled without RGB alteration. Mirrored periodic source swatches, byte-identical certified alpha masks and old navy boundary guide only.

stage_floor.periodicMethod: 128px source quarter mirrored on X and Y for exact opposing seams
